record.paper: Coloring count cones of planar graphs

dossier_meta.paper: Coloring count cones of planar graphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: Every plane near-cubic graph $\tilde{G}$ with $d(\tilde{G}) = 5$ satisfies $n_{\tilde{G}} \in B'_5$.
dossier_meta.context_text: The cone $B'_5$ is defined as the subcone of $B_5$ spanned by the rays $\operatorname{ray}(\tilde{R}_{5,1}), \ldots, \operatorname{ray}(\tilde{R}_{5,11})$, excluding the ray corresponding to the non-planar graph $\tilde{R}_{5,12}$. By Lemma 7, membership of $n_{\tilde{G}}$ in the full cone $B_5$ is equivalent to the Four Color Theorem, so this conjecture is a strict strengthening of the Four Color Theorem. The authors verify it for all plane near-cubic graphs with fewer than 30 vertices.
